text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A month before the Arima Kinen, I<n>open my mail one
morning to a letter<n>from the academy. Inside, I find
midterm tallies for the race's<n>nominations.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For the second year in a row, I find<n>Grass
Wonder's name on the list.<n>Then, I check which of
her rivals<n>we're likely to see on the big day.
There's one familiar name listed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the racers themselves<n>have seen these
tallies yet.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you for a lovely meal!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nothin' beats a clean plate and a full<n>belly!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe never did show up, though, did<n>she?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Right? She just left that message<n>sayin' "start
without me!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But have ya noticed, Grass?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There's somethin' different about<n>Spe these days.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I have noticed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I suspect I'll be facing her in the<n>Arima.
Should it come to that—oh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hm? That a message from your<n>trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's Spe. She says she wants to<n>speak with me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: She said what?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, and there's a rather spirited<n>tone to her
writing. ...I can hardly wait<n>to meet her on the roof.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm... So, now Spe's the one gettin'<n>all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Is that envy I'm detecting?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?!
H-hold up! What makes you say<n>that?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I apologize for the wait, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to call you up so suddenly.<n>Thanks for coming
though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Have you seen the Arima tallies yet?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course.
You'll be racing in the Arima Kinen,<n>yes, Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh.
And... I'm gonna beat you, Grass.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I saw the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You, Suzuka, El... You were all<n>amazing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It was almost scary, seeing you three<n>at full force.
You were so powerful...<n>so blindingly bright...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...And so distant.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My friends... The people I admire...<n>Everyone was
out there giving their<n>all on the same track.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Except me! I'm the only one being<n>left behind!
I won't let it go on like this. I won't.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to show you all what I can do!<n>I'm gonna
compete right along with<n>you.
And I wanna win!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is mine.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll make my moms proud... Because<n>I'm Special
Week, the top<n>Umamusume in all of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll face you with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...And that is the situation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe is training especially hard. I'm<n>certain she'll be
almost<n>unrecognizable in a month's time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I pledged my determination. I'll<n>train just as
hard and accomplish<n>what I've set out to do.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I suppose I am.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Maruzen, Sei, El, Suzuka, and now<n>Spe...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Each of them are truly strong.<n>Overcoming them will
be no easy<n>task.
But overcome them I will—one by one.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Each time will affirm my progress,<n>each step
becoming a source of my<n>strength.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That is how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the smile on Grass Wonder's<n>face, I'm
reminded of the words<n>Maruzensky told me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But, hey. Grass will be fine. Just<n>peachy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: After all...

There's one important thing she's<n>always had
tons and tons of.<n>Something I never had, no matter
how<n>I longed for it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky was revered as the<n>Beast because
there was nobody<n>else who could match her
strength.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But Grass Wonder is surrounded by<n>others pushing
her to do better.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer... shall we begin our<n>meeting?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We still have so much training to do!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder is set to take a major<n>leap forward
at the Arima Kinen.<n>There's no doubt in my mind!
